title: OEBF Slab
description: A flat horizontal element (floor, roof, landing) defined by a closed boundary path extruded vertically by a given thickness.

function.description: What the slab does, as for a profile layer. A 'membrane' slab (a DPM or a roofing membrane laid as its own sheet) is drawn as a membrane: always on top in 3D and as a heavy line in 2D, and exported to IFC as an IfcCovering of type MEMBRANE. A slab whose material has the category 'membrane' is drawn the same way.

elevation_m.description: Z elevation of the top face in metres. Defaults to 0.0.
